AGENDA

OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

Monthly Investment Transaction Report – May 31, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review and accept the Monthly Investment Transaction Report as of May 31, 2019 pursuant to the City’s FY 2018-19 Investment Policy.
Staff Report
4.
Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation Request to Increase Its Initiation Fee Schedule
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the request of the Palos Verdes Tennis Foundation to increase its initiation fee schedule with an effective date of July 1, 2019.
Staff Report
5.
Merchant and Banking Services Agreements
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this update regarding the City’s banking and merchant fee structure and savings to the City.
Staff Report
6.
Consideration of Traffic Safety Committee Recommendations of June 5, 2019
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council review and approve the Traffic Safety Committee recommendations to add diagonal striping on Via Zurita between Via Fernandez and Via Lopez and to install red curb markings and signage at the Via Alcance/Via Cardelina intersection.
Staff Report
7.
Extension of Agreements for Fiscal Year 2019-20
Recommendation: It is recommended the City Council approve the contract extensions for Venco Western, Inc., Travers Tree Service, Inc. and Mountain Recreations & Conservation Authority, and authorize the Mayor to execute the amendments to extend the agreements.
Staff Report
8.
Approval of Professional Services Agreement for Storm Drain No. 3 (2900 Paseo Del Mar Outfall) Energy Dissipater-Impact Basin Reconstruction/Replacement/ Rehabilitation
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the award of a professional services agreement with GMU Geotechnical, Inc. as approved by the City Attorney for the Storm Drain No. 3 (2900 Paseo Del Mar Outfall) Energy Dissipator-Impact Basin Reconstruction/Replacement/Rehabilitation.
Staff Report
9.
Approval of Engagement Agreement with Kutak Rock LLP for the Ben K. Kazarian (BKK) Carson Landfill Tolling Agreement
Recommendation: It is recommended that City Council approve the Engagement Agreement with Kutak Rock LLP for the Ben K. Kazarian (BKK) Carson Landfill Tolling Agreement and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement.
Staff Report
10.
State Cannabis Regulations Update
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to State law, no action can be taken by the Council this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Council determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Council agenda.
ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING(S) - NONE

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve and adopt the City’s Fiscal Year (FY) 2019-20 year two of the Biennial Operating Budget and Capital Plan, Resolution R19-19, and fixing the limitation of expenditures for the several purposes, functions, funds and activities; and adopt Resolution R19-18 establishing the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Appropriations Limit.

Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the FY 2019-20 Palos Verdes Stable budget, including dollars for capital expenditures.
